name: M7.Selection.win_membership
statement: ∀ (α : Type) (T : Finset α) (feasible : α → Prop) (R : α → α → Prop) (x : α), x ∈ M7.Selection.winners T feasible R ↔ M7.Selection.win T feasible R x
